name: Zero Padding for Aliasing Reduction
definition: A technique to reduce aliasing artifacts caused by imperfect resampling filters (energy in the stop band). By zero padding the original dataset, energy in the stop band projects zeros instead of dataset data, nullifying artifacts.
summary: Zero padding for aliasing reduction extends a volume with zeros to prevent stop-band energy from projecting artifacts, distinguishing it from boundary handling by eliminating overlapping spectral replicas without rendering performance overhead.
